property_summary: For every key k, the owed balance c.balances(k) can never exceed the ETH c actually holds (each credit is backed by real Ether); the mutant leaves balances(k) set after paying it out, so after a successful withdraw balances(k) > address(c).balance for some k.
change_summary: Delete the statement zeroing the caller's balance after the transfer, so balances retain their pre-withdraw value.
